yu: n. 禹（傳說的中國古代聖君）
yuan:
n. 元(中國貨幣單位)
[經] 元

n. the basic unit of money in China
n. the imperial dynasty of China from 1279 to 1368
<dl class="nd"><dt>語感</dt><dd>中性，貨幣單位</dd><dt>詞根詞綴</dt><dd>借自漢語「元」</dd><dt class="w">注意事項</dt><dd class="w">單複數同形，如 100 yuan</dd></dl>
yuca: n. 木薯, 木薯根莖, 木薯澱粉
<dl class="nd"><dt>詞源</dt><dd class="et">新拉丁語 jucca，源自15世紀泰諾語 yuca</dd></dl>
yucca:
n. 絲蘭
[醫] 絲蘭屬
n. any of several evergreen plants of the genus Yucca having usually tall stout stems and a terminal cluster of white flowers; warmer regions of North America
<dl class="nd"><dt>語感</dt><dd>中性，植物名</dd><dt>詞根詞綴</dt><dd>Longman：1500-1600 西班牙語 yuca，源自泰諾語（Taino）</dd></dl>
yuck: int. [美俚]啐（表示反感等, 等於yuk）

v. i. To itch.
v. t. To scratch.
<dl class="nd"><dt>語感</dt><dd>口語感嘆詞（辭典標 informal）</dd><dt>詞根詞綴</dt><dd>1900–2000 年，擬嘔吐聲而來</dd><dt>字族</dt><dd>yucky (形容詞)</dd></dl>
yucky: a. 令人討厭的, 難以下嚥的
s highly offensive; arousing aversion or disgust

<dl class="nd"><dt>語感</dt><dd>口語（字典標 informal），小孩子說話常見</dd><dt>詞根詞綴</dt><dd>yuck（表示噁心的感嘆聲）＋ -y</dd><dt>常見搭配</dt><dd>yucky food；felt yucky</dd><dt class="w">注意事項</dt><dd class="w">可形容味道、外觀，也可形容身體不適的感覺（I felt yucky）</dd></dl>
yugoslav: a. 南斯拉夫的；南斯拉夫人的
n. a native or inhabitant of Yugoslavia
yuk: n. 引起大笑的趣事；[俚]（因有趣而發出的）咯咯大笑
<dl class="nd"><dt>語感</dt><dd>整體中性；第 1、2 義為俚語</dd><dt>詞源</dt><dd class="et">擬聲</dd></dl>
yukon:
n. a North American river that flows westward from the Yukon Territory through central Alaska to the Bering Sea
n. a territory in northwestern Canada; site of the Klondike gold rush in the 1890s
yule: n. (基督教)聖誕節, 聖誕節期
n period extending from Dec. 24 to Jan. 6
yuletide: n period extending from Dec. 24 to Jan. 6
yum: int. 極好的；妙的；美味的
<dl class="nd"><dt>語感</dt><dd>非正式感嘆詞，口語</dd><dt>詞根詞綴</dt><dd>1800-1900 年間，來自雙唇相碰發出的聲音（擬聲詞）</dd><dt>近義詞</dt><dd>mmm：同樣表達滿意，聲音更含糊</dd></dl>
yum-yum: int. 唔唔(用以表示滿足,愉快之感嘆詞)
yummy: a. 美味的, 可口的, 賞心悅目的, 愉快的
s extremely pleasing to the sense of taste

<dl class="nd"><dt>語感</dt><dd>非正式，口語</dd><dt>詞根詞綴</dt><dd>1800-1900 年間，由 yum 加 -y 構成</dd><dt>常見搭配</dt><dd>a yummy dessert；yummy dishes；yummy cake</dd><dt>近義詞</dt><dd>delicious：美味的，較一般、較不兒語化</dd><dt class="w">注意事項</dt><dd class="w">yummy 帶童趣，常用於跟小孩說話或輕鬆場合</dd></dl>
yuppie: n. （美）雅皮士（屬於中上階層的年輕專業人士）
n. a young upwardly mobile professional individual; a well-paid middle-class professional who works in a city and has a luxurious life style

<dl class="nd"><dt>語感</dt><dd>常帶貶義，用來描述城市裡收入高、生活講究的年輕專業人士</dd><dt>詞根詞綴</dt><dd>縮寫詞，由 young urban professional 的字首組成（加上 -ie 字尾）</dd><dt>常見搭配</dt><dd>yuppie friends；a bunch of yuppies</dd><dt>典故</dt><dd>Formed from the first letters of the words 'young urban professional'. 由 young urban professional 的首字母組成。</dd></dl>
yuppy: n. 雅皮士（特指肆意揮霍, 追趕時髦的年輕人）
yuri: n. 尤里（男子名）；坂崎由莉（遊戲拳皇中的女性角色）
yurt: n. a circular domed dwelling that is portable and self-supporting; originally used by nomadic Mongol and Turkic people of central Asia but now used as inexpensive alternative or temporary housing
